name: Conventions page lists the seeded candidates and merges one into a draft skill
description: Covers the L02 Conventions extractor on seeded data: the SKILLS LAB nav item opens the repo-scoped /repos/:repoId/conventions route for the active repo, the seeded convention_scans row drives the 'Detected from 84 sample files' subtitle, the three seeded candidates render with their evidence path and confidence percentage, accepting one moves the 'N of M accepted' counter, and Create skill opens the merge modal with the client-side draft body. The extraction itself is NEVER driven — there is no LLM and no key in this suite, and the demo repo has clonePath: null so the extract route would 422 anyway; seed-conventions.ts seeds the output for exactly that reason. The repo id is not hardcoded: the flow follows the home redirect to the first repo's PR list and then clicks the sidebar item, whose :repoId template resolveHref fills from the active repo — the same mechanism a user uses, and the only one the runner supports ({BASE} is the sole substitution). Note the `wait --load networkidle` after each navigation: every page here renders a skeleton until its TanStack Query resolves and `wait --url` matches the moment the URL changes (e2e/.context/insights/INSIGHTS.md). Accept is located as `role button --name Accept --exact`: the sidebar renders nav items as links so `role button` cannot match them, and `--exact` is what keeps it off 'Accept all' and 'Accepted', both of which a default case-insensitive substring match would also hit. Unlike the read-only flows above, this one WRITES — it accepts a candidate — so a re-run needs a re-seeded DB: use the hermetic runner (see e2e/README.md), which also guarantees the seeded demo repo is the first repo the home redirect lands on.
